description: Nadia, 12 people, three LUMA 9719-4 in walnut, AED 6,000; delivery/assembly; then wrong-layout 'yes' and 'keep it'.

turns.text: Hi, I'm Nadia. We're furnishing a new office in Dubai for twelve people and want three LUMA 9719-4 workstations in walnut, budget AED 6,000.
Do you provide delivery and assembly in Dubai?

notes: Bot replies are not scripted. 'ыгку' is 'yes' typed on a Russian keyboard layout; it only means consent if the preceding reply asked whether to prepare a quotation, which the prior_bot_asked check records.

checks.description: No turn sends raw JSON/claim-contract payload as the customer reply.
No reply says a named/selected product 'isn't confirmed' / 'not confirmed'.
Turn 2 answers delivery and installation positively.
Records whether the reply before 'ыгку' asked whether to prepare a quotation.
'ыгку' and 'keep it' proceed to quotation details (or a quotation) with no re-listing of options.
checks.proceed_pattern: e-?mail|company|delivery address|full name|quotation SO-|has been prepared
